using namespace std;

using ll = long long;

const ll INF = 9'000'000'000'000'000'000LL;

ll fib_like[17], target, best;

ll abs_val(ll x) { return x < 0 ? -x : x; }

void dfs(int idx, ll cur_sum, ll cost) {
    if (cur_sum == 0) {
        best = min(best, cost);
        return;
    }
    if (idx == 0) return;

    for (int d = -10; d <= 10; ++d) {
        ll new_sum = cur_sum + d * fib_like[idx];
        if (new_sum > 0) {
            dfs(idx - 1, new_sum, cost + abs_val(d) * idx);
            break;
        }
    }

    for (int d = -10; d <= 10; ++d) {
        ll new_sum = cur_sum + d * fib_like[idx];
        if (new_sum == 0) {
            dfs(idx - 1, new_sum, cost + abs_val(d) * idx);
            break;
        }
    }

    for (int d = 10; d >= -10; --d) {
        ll new_sum = cur_sum + d * fib_like[idx];
        if (new_sum < 0) {
            dfs(idx - 1, new_sum, cost + abs_val(d) * idx);
            break;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> target;

    fib_like[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= 16; ++i)
        fib_like[i] = fib_like[i-1] * 10 + 1;

    best = INF;
    dfs(16, target, 0);

    cout << best << '\n';
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <climits>

using namespace std;

using i64 = long long;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    i64 n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<i64> seq(17);
    seq[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= 16; ++i)
        seq[i] = seq[i-1] * 10 + 1;

    i64 best = LLONG_MAX;

    function<void(int, i64, i64)> solve = [&](int idx, i64 cur, i64 cost) {
        if (cur == 0) {
            best = min(best, cost);
            return;
        }
        if (idx == 0) return;

        auto tryMove = [&](int start, int end, int step, auto cond) {
            for (int d = start; d != end + step; d += step) {
                i64 nv = cur + d * seq[idx];
                if (cond(nv)) {
                    solve(idx - 1, nv, cost + llabs(d) * idx);
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        };

        tryMove(-10, 10, 1, [](i64 x){ return x > 0; }) ||
        tryMove(-10, 10, 1, [](i64 x){ return x == 0; }) ||
        tryMove(10, -10, -1, [](i64 x){ return x < 0; });
    };

    solve(16, n, 0);
    cout << best << '\n';
    return 0;
}
